texto: The imperfective presents an activity or the background of a scene: **padał deszcz**, **wracaliśmy**. The perfect focuses on a complete fact: **przyjechał**, **usłyszeliśmy**.
The verbal time alone is not enough: the aspect provides information on how the fact is seen within the story.
